    - 'heading "Linear First-Order Equations: Integrating Factor Pipeline" [level=1]'
    - paragraph: Solve y′+2y=eˣ using an integrating factor. Connect each symbolic step to its graph and residual check.
    - text: 18 min ADVANCED CONCEPT calculus integrating factor
    - heading "▦ INTEGRATING-FACTOR PIPELINE" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Solve y′+2y=eˣ with initial condition y(0)=1.
    - text: Standard form y′+P(x)y=Q(x) P(x) 2 Q(x) eˣ Method Integrating Factor
    - button "Reset lab":
      - img
      - text: Reset lab
    - article:
      - button "Stage 1": "1"
      - heading "Identify P(x) and Q(x)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: P(x)=2, Q(x)=eˣ
      - text: Original ODE direction field
      - img
      - complementary:
        - text: Residual check
        - paragraph: R(x,y)=y′+2y−eˣ
        - strong: Pending
    - article:
      - button "Stage 2": "2"
      - heading "Compute integrating factor (IF)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: μ(x)=e^(∫2dx)=e²ˣ
      - text: Integrating factor μ(x)=e²ˣ
      - img
      - complementary:
        - text: Residual check
        - paragraph: R(x,y)=y′+2y−eˣ
        - strong: Pending
    - article:
      - button "Stage 3": "3"
      - heading "Multiply every term by μ(x)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: e²ˣy′+2e²ˣy=e³ˣ
      - text: All terms multiplied
      - img
      - complementary:
        - text: Residual check
        - paragraph: R(x,y)=y′+2y−eˣ
        - strong: Will be 0 for solution
    - article:
      - button "Stage 4": "4"
      - heading "Recognize exact derivative" [level=3]
      - paragraph: d/dx(ye²ˣ)=e³ˣ
      - text: Derivative check
      - img
      - complementary:
        - text: Residual check
        - paragraph: R(x,y)=y′+2y−eˣ
        - strong: Identically true
    - article:
      - button "Stage 5": "5"
      - heading "Integrate both sides" [level=3]
      - paragraph: ye²ˣ=e³ˣ/3+C
      - text: Compare both sides
      - img
      - complementary:
        - text: Residual check
        - paragraph: R(x,y)=y′+2y−eˣ
        - strong: Derivative residual 0
    - article:
      - button "Stage 6": "6"
      - heading "Solve for y(x)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: y=eˣ/3+Ce⁻²ˣ
      - text: General solution family
      - img
      - complementary:
        - text: Residual check
        - paragraph: R(x,y)=y′+2y−eˣ
        - strong: ODE residual 0
    - article:
      - button "Stage 7": "7"
      - heading "Apply initial condition y(0)=1" [level=3]

      - text: Particular solution (C=2/3)
      - img
      - complementary:
        - text: Residual check
        - paragraph: R(x,y)=y′+2y−eˣ
        - strong: Verified
    - article:

      - paragraph: "With y(0)=1: y=eˣ/3+(2/3)e⁻²ˣ"
      - paragraph: "Check at x=0: 1/3+2/3=1 ✓"
      - paragraph: "ODE residual: y′+2y−eˣ=0 ✓"
    - article:
      - heading "▦ Standard Form" [level=3]
      - paragraph: A first-order linear ODE is y′+P(x)y=Q(x).
      - paragraph: "Our equation: y′+2y=eˣ"
      - paragraph: P(x)=2, Q(x)=eˣ
    - article:
      - heading "⌘ Common Mistakes" [level=3]
      - list:
        - listitem: Wrong sign in P(x).
        - listitem: Forgetting the constant.
        - listitem: Not multiplying every term by μ(x).
        - listitem: Incorrectly integrating e³ˣ.
        - listitem: Applying the initial condition incorrectly.
    - article:
      - heading "◇ Key Takeaways" [level=3]
      - list:
        - listitem: Identify P(x) and Q(x).
        - listitem: Compute μ(x)=e^(∫Pdx).
        - listitem: Multiply every term by μ(x).
        - listitem: Recognize the exact derivative.
        - listitem: Integrate, solve, and apply the initial condition.
    - article:
      - heading "▧ Explore & Visualize" [level=3]
      - list:
